name: Lysergol
summary: Lysergol, also known as LOL (from Lysergol) or as 9,10-didehydro-6-methyl-8β-hydroxymethylergoline, is an alkaloid of the ergoline family that occurs as a minor constituent in some species of fungi (most within Claviceps), and in the morning glory family of flowering plants, including the hallucinogenic seeds of Rivea corymbosa (ololiuhqui), Argyreia nervosa (Hawaiian baby woodrose), and Ipomoea violacea.

pharmacology.text: The binding of lysergol, as well as of isolysergol, to the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors has been described. It is an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor and α1-adrenergic receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

summaryZh: 麥角醇（英語：Lysergol，或譯為全物麥角醇）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C16H18N2O，屬於麥角靈類生物鹼。
summaryZhHans: 麦角醇（英语：Lysergol，或译为全物麦角醇）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式为C16H18N2O，属于麦角灵类生物碱。

uses.en: It is a minor natural alkaloid of morning glory seeds and ergot fungi, mainly of research interest. It has no established medical use.
uses.zh: 麥角醇是牽牛花種子與麥角菌中含量很少的天然生物鹼，主要具研究價值，沒有確立的醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 麦角醇是牵牛花种子与麦角菌中含量很少的天然生物碱，主要具研究价值，没有确立的医疗用途。

fact.en: Unlike LSD, lysergol has no amide: its key position carries a simple hydroxymethyl group, which makes it an alcohol and explains the -ol at the end of its name.
fact.zh: 與 LSD 不同，麥角醇沒有醯胺：它的關鍵位置上只有一個簡單的羥甲基，因此屬於醇類，名稱結尾的「-ol」就是由此而來。
fact.zhHans: 与 LSD 不同，麦角醇没有酰胺：它的关键位置上只有一个简单的羟甲基，因此属于醇类，名称结尾的「-ol」就是由此而来。
